title: Synaptic Event v1.0
description: Real-time activity event emitted by adapters and consumed by the dashboard.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the event.

adapter_id.description: Stable identifier of the adapter that emitted this event (e.g. 'claude-code-hooks', 'mcp-passive', 'otel-anthropic').

session_id.description: Optional session identifier; consecutive events from the same agent run share this.

payload.description: Event-type-specific data. See docs/event-schema.md for per-type payload conventions. Common fields: text, tool_name, args, result, memory_id, region_hint, error_message.
